breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The ground truth resolves the contradiction by removing the half-shift instruction entirely, leaving only the gamma-centered k-point grid specification. The generated specification instead attempts to reconcile both conflicting instructions by keeping the half-shift (shifts 1 1 1) while claiming even grid dimensions make it gamma-centered. This still repeats the erroneous half-shift instruction rather than cleanly removing it as the ground truth does.
